name: auto-geo
description: GEO content automation expert: turn any user-given product/category topic into multi-platform articles and a theme page with natural brand placement and ad-law compliance.

displayDescription.en: GEO content automation: turn any product/category topic into multi-platform articles and a theme page with natural brand placement and ad-law compliance.
displayDescription.zh: GEO 内容自动化：围绕用户给定产品/类目生成多平台文章与主题页，品牌自然嵌入并确保广告法合规。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我配置 GEO 内容自动化：先引导我填写品牌名、产品类目、知识库 ID、归档文件夹与输出目录等参数
defaultInitPrompt.en: Set up GEO content automation: guide me through brand name, product category, knowledge base ID, archive folder and output directory

quickPrompts.en: Set up GEO content automation: guide me through brand name, product category, knowledge base ID, archive folder and output directory
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我配置 GEO 内容自动化：先引导我填写品牌名、产品类目、知识库 ID、归档文件夹与输出目录等参数

quickPrompts.en: Generate a full set of GEO content for a given product/category (Xiaohongshu / WeChat / Zhihu / Toutiao / theme page)
quickPrompts.zh: 围绕某产品/类目生成一套 GEO 内容（小红书 / 公众号 / 知乎 / 头条号 / 主题页）

quickPrompts.en: Push the last generated GEO content to my knowledge base and self-check ad-law compliance
quickPrompts.zh: 把上次生成的 GEO 内容推送到我的知识库，并自查广告法合规
